title: Trick or Treat Chest

The '''Trick or Treat Chest''' is a chest that has a {{Green|1-3%}} chance (depending on the Mob) of appearing when killing any mob during the [[Spooky Festival]]. After the player interacts with it, it will open similarly to a [[Dungeon Chest]] and either reward the player with {{RawMctxt|&6&lTREAT}} or spawn a [[Spooky Mobs|Spooky Mob]] with {{RawMctxt|&c&lTRICK}}. If the chest is left untouched, it will despawn and disappear after some time.

The player cannot open other players' '''Trick or Treat Chests''' or steal their rewards.

== Outcomes ==
The {{RawMctxt|&6&lTREAT}} outcome can give {{Green|1-3}} types of loot. Opening a '''Trick or Treat Chest''' has a {{Green|75%}} chance to result in a {{RawMctxt|&6&lTREAT}}.

The {{RawMctxt|&c&lTRICK}} outcome will spawn a [[Spooky Mobs|Spooky Mob]]. Opening a '''Trick or Treat Chest''' has a {{Green|25%}} chance to result in a {{RawMctxt|&c&lTRICK}}.
